messages.author: 599b212f6d25d24b
messages.subject: Defining DMRs
parts:
Hi Dr. Akalin, 

I was wondering if there is a way to define gap penalties for consecutive cpg's while defining DMR's in methylKit. 

I would like to find differentially methylated regions across two conditions while defining DMRs as regions of three or more consecutive differentially methylated sites with an average absolute methylation

difference of ≥ 5% between groups. 


Is it possible to define this using the tiling approach in methylKit? 




Faraz.

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Defining DMRs
parts:
Hi Faraz,
You can define DMCs individually and call DMRs if two of them are shorter than a cut off distance. IF you know your way around GenomicRanges package it shouldn't be so difficult to build distance based clustering of DMCs. You might have to do a second round of filtering based on your other constraints once you have clustered DMCs by distance.

Best,
Altuna
